known_issues.fix: SetupEMA binds the shadow to the model's device on load
known_issues.found_by: the D10 smoke, check 8, first attempt
known_issues.severity: would have killed any resumed production run
known_issues.summary: SetupEMA.load_state_dict preserved the checkpoint payload's device. A paired checkpoint serializes the setup EMA to CPU and read_joint_checkpoint maps to CPU, so a resume on the MPS production device left a CPU shadow accumulating against MPS parameters and SetupEMA.update raised on the first setup update after the resume.
known_issues.why_it_survived: Agent 4's resume rehearsal ran on CPU on purpose, because MPS is not bitwise reproducible run to run, so the device mismatch could not occur there. The D10 smoke is the first thing to resume on the production device.

known_issues.consequence: the hour 6-12 learning curve loses one row per resume and record_index no longer tracks the iteration number. Every row carries system.iteration, so a reader realigns by that field rather than by position.
known_issues.measured: the smoke's log holds iterations 1, 2, 4 at record indices 0, 1, 2; iteration 3's row is gone although its weights were checkpointed and restored
known_issues.not_changed_because: this is Agent 4's accepted checkpoint/append ordering and the row's own content includes the checkpoint identity, so reversing the order is a restructure of machinery the 4B brief says to reuse rather than rebuild. Operator call.
known_issues.severity: telemetry only; training and checkpoints unaffected
known_issues.summary: one telemetry row is lost per resume. TrainingSession.step writes the checkpoint BEFORE it appends the row, so the checkpoint's telemetry_position excludes the row of the iteration it was taken at. TelemetryWriter.resume then truncates that row back and the next iteration writes into its record slot.

measured_in_the_smoke.advantage_balance_note: the printed advantage's entropy term is several times the outcome term, which is the deliberate consequence of D10 section 4 keeping `alpha * (I - h)` with I in nats while L_h targets I/10. Recorded per iteration, not compensated for.
